description: Capability for the generic less-privileged sandboxed webview (label 'sandboxed-webview', see shared_structures_tauri_rust::SANDBOXED_WEBVIEW_LABEL). Used to open arbitrary external (non-Tauri) pages — e.g. a launched app — in a window that does NOT inherit the main webview's surface. Grants only the multiplexed event bus and log access; core:default is deliberately withheld because the loaded external page shares the webview's JS context. `remote.urls` is required: the webview navigates to arbitrary external http(s):// URLs (Origin::Remote), and without a matching urlpattern every IPC call is rejected as `not allowed on window`. The pattern is permissive because launched-app / external hosts can't be enumerated ahead of time. Security: the threat model assumes the loaded page may be adversarial — anything reachable here, the page can reach too. The Owner bearer is NOT exposed to JS: it stays host-side (presented on direct-loopback API requests by the host's loopback-provenance owner trust), and there is no host command that returns it.
